Picked up this gen 5.5 iPod in 2008 when I finished college and went to travel.
 It has been all over the world with me and got me through more than enough tough times and long bus journeys! It was my constant companion.
 Had been sitting on my shelf for years and had always loved seeing people bring them back to life.
 Finally bit the bullet and had someone install a 3000mah battery and 256gb sd card (didn’t trust myself not to mess it up) and I’m in love all over again! 😍
 Stuck with the original white faceplate and picked up a cheap red case from eBay.
    submitted by    /u/Frankmagnet7    to    r/IpodClassic
